storage: local Docker named volume; loopback HTTP; no TLS or artificial network delay
limitations: Short probes identify candidate rates, not sustained or 30-day capacity.
Shared host workloads may affect results; no other containers are stopped.
SDK events and adapter wire output are recorded once, then replayed with new identities.
Verification retains encoded replay descriptions, releases them page by page and accumulates per-view summaries; every complete payload is reconstructed and checked after restart.
OTLP batching and gzip model a gateway; SDK adapters still send one event per request.
Request latency starts after serialization/compression; preparation and schedule lag are reported separately.
Resource sampling includes Docker exec overhead and may miss peaks. Container memory includes filesystem cache.
Scheduled retention scans run every five seconds with a 30-day TTL; these runs do not measure deletion of expired data.

Optional aggregate profiling covers the process lifetime, including preload, health checks and startup retention, but excludes schema initialization and final checkpoint. It is unavailable after SIGKILL. Queue depth and internal timing percentiles are not measured.
Image ID identifies the executable. Git source provenance is the local checkout and cannot attest to a separately supplied image.

verification_ledger_memory_preflight.description: Isolated retained verification ledger at the planned maximum. Excludes HTTP, latency arrays, and server memory.

measurement_notes: The generic runner limitation saying no other containers are stopped does not apply: the wrapper stopped and restored 13 development containers.
This single run includes preload in the collector profiles. The earlier matched comparison restarted after preload and excluded it.
Host memory samples include preload, traffic, verification and restoration. They are system-wide, not attributable to the collector alone.
Per-minute scheduling and omission buckets use due times; sent, success and latency buckets use submission times. Boundary requests can move between adjacent buckets.
The isolated 950,000-entry ledger memory preflight excluded HTTP activity and latency tracking, and did not predict live generator peak RSS.
The runner stopped traffic when generator RSS exceeded 1024 MiB. It then drained, gracefully restarted, verified every acknowledged event and removed the disposable volume.

evidence_review.scope: Report, raw results, source/image identity, restoration and host-memory evidence; no extra tests or Docker runs.
